title: [GB] GovTalk: migrate SendHttpRequest from DotNet HttpWebRequest to native HttpClient
summary: GovTalk message submission migrated from deprecated DotNet HttpWebRequest to native HttpClient for HTTP communication with HMRC.
key_points: SendHttpRequest now uses native HttpClient, HttpRequestMessage and HttpResponseMessage instead of DotNet HttpWebRequest via Web Request Helper
The same migration is applied to the GovTalk app (codeunit 10569) and the obsolete GB Base App copy (codeunit 10520)
Admin controls on outbound extension HTTP calls now apply to GovTalk submissions
The progress dialog opens only when GuiAllowed; POST, text/xml, redirects and the 100s timeout are unchanged
Two new HttpClientHandler tests cover a successful POST with XML parsing and a non-200 status returning false
